Career Journey

A BUET Mechanical Engineering graduate of the Class of 1983, Jamal went on to complete an MSc and PhD, building a career in academia in Australia. He now serves as Professor at Swinburne University of Technology, where he teaches engineering and supervises research — carrying BUET's engineering foundation into the training of the next generation.
